diagnosis: The route retrieves an ExpenseReport solely by expense_id and navigates through SQLModel relationships (expense.project.department) to expose departmental budget and internal ledger data. It does not verify that the requesting user is a member of the project or department, allowing any authenticated employee to inspect confidential financial ledger data of any department.
exploit_request:
GET /api/v1/expenses/9102/audit-context HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <employee_token>
